{{Short description|22nd season of the National Hurling League}} {{Use dmy dates|date=April 2022}} {{Infobox GAA League |league = 1952–53 National Hurling League |image = |dates =26 October 1952 – 19 April 1953 |teams = |team1 = Cork |captain1 = [[David O'Leary (hurler)|David O'Leary]] |manager1 = |titles = 6th |team2 = |captain2 = |manager2 = |previous = [[1951–52 National Hurling League|1951–52]] |next = [[1953–54 National Hurling League|1953–54]] }} The '''1952–53 National Hurling League''' was the 22nd season of the [[National Hurling League]]. ==Division 1== {{Infobox football league season |competition=[[National Hurling League|National Hurling League Division 1]] |image = |season=1952-53 |winners=[[Cork GAA|Cork]]
6th National League title
Captain: [[David O'Leary (hurler)|David O'Leary]] |relegated= |continentalcup1= |continentalcup1 qualifiers= |continentalcup2= |continentalcup2 qualifiers= |league topscorer= |best goalkeeper= |biggest home win= |biggest away win= |highest scoring= |matches= |total goals= |longest wins= |longest unbeaten= |longest winless= |longest losses= |highest attendance= |lowest attendance= |attendance= |average attendance= |prevseason=[[1951–52 National Hurling League|1951–52]] |nextseason=[[1953–54 National Hurling League|1953-54]] |updated=19 March 2017 }} [[Tipperary GAA|Tipperary]] came into the season as defending champions of the [[1951-52 National Hurling League|1951-52 season]]. On 19 April 1953, [[Cork GAA|Cork]] won the title after a 2-10 to 2-7 win over [[Tipperary GAA|Tipperary]] in the final. It was their 6th league title overall and their first since [[1947-48 National Hurling League|1947-48]].{{cite web|url=http://www.hoganstand.com/general/leagues/nhlrecords.aspx|title=National Hurling
